card.name: Words just before a step reference
card.fires_on: Small words like "in", "Repeat", "at" or "with" in numbered instructions, right where the next word is likely "step" or "Step" followed by a number.

modes.label: Result from an earlier step
modes.description: "in" after a verb such as determined, obtained or prepared, pointing back to a numbered step.
modes.example: Measure the volume of liquid determined<< in>> Step 3 by using a calibrated measuring

modes.label: Repeat or continue instruction
modes.description: "Repeat", "at" or "with" in a numbered instruction that sends the reader to other steps.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write the word "step" next.
card.plain: It fires on the words just before a procedure refers back to an earlier numbered step.
